newsitem.title: USA: CKE sets stock offer to cover acquisition.
newsitem.headline: CKE sets stock offer to cover acquisition.

text.p: CKE Restaurants Inc Monday said it will offer over 8.3 million common shares to pay for its $327 million acquisition of hamburger restaurant chain Hardee's Food Systems Inc.
In addition, CKE said it has named Rory Murphy to succeed Stephen McManus as president and chief operating officer of Hardee's when CKE completes the acquisition.
The deal is expected to close in July.

Murphy will be responsible for the 3,152-unit Hardee's system and its integration into CKE. Murphy currently is executive vice president of CKE, responsible for the operation of its 678 company, franchised and international Carl's Jr. restaurants, 26 Rally's locations and 107 Taco Bueno restaurants.
He also oversees the functions of facilities maintenance, quality assurance, product optimization, training and development, distribution, restaurant information systems and public relations.

In a statement, CKE said plans call for it to test the dual branding of CKE's Carl's Jr. concept with Hardee's, serving Hardee's breakfasts with Carl's Jr.'s charbroiled burgers and chicken sandwiches.
If the test is successful, restaurants throughout Hardee's system could be converted to the dual-brand concept, CKE said.
